text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening thesis in favor of driverless cars","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its position early and directly, making the argument easy to follow from the start."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on money, safety, and passenger benefits","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups its reasons into distinct body paragraphs that create a more orderly argument."},{"evidence":"mentions Sergey Brin, fuel savings, alerts, sensors","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses several details from the article to back up its claims rather than relying mainly on personal opinion."},{"evidence":"\"Although this is a major concern, I believe that we can get past these concerns\"","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges objections and then responds to them instead of ignoring the opposing side."},{"evidence":"repeats that cars are safer and can save lives in the conclusion","quality":"conclusion development","description":"The ending restates the position and main benefits in a way that more fully wraps up the argument."}]}
